opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied. Justice SOTOMAYOR, with whom Justice GINSBURG joins, dissenting from the denial of certiorari: I dissent for the reasons set out in Brown v. United States, 586 U.S. ----, --- S.Ct. ----, ---L.Ed.2d ---- (2018) (Sotomayor, J., dissenting).
